title: Policy 463.10 quarterly external-user audits — Dec 2025 forward
summary:
Asks for the quarterly audit of external CA public agency users that Policy 463.10 requires alongside the monthly internal audit, covering 2025-12-22 through the date of production:

- Item 1: each memorandum to the Chief of Police documenting a quarterly external-user audit, under whichever quarterly schedule the Department applies.
- Item 2: any record establishing the quarterly schedule or audit calendar — an audit calendar, scheduling or tasking record, or assignment to the ALPR Committee Captain or designee.
- Item 3: for each audit, the record identifying which external CA public agencies were reviewed, including any list of network-sharing partners in effect during the audited period.
- Item 4: records sufficient to identify the "associated documentation" filed and retained — file names, export dates, covering date ranges, source platform — without producing the underlying exports.
- Item 5: records of the Chief's review of each memorandum and its filing and retention, with dates.

The request notes that W012461-040226 produced four monthly memoranda (December 2025 – March 2026) with the statement "We have no additional records," and that more than two quarterly periods have since closed under any schedule. It asks the Department to identify which memorandum constitutes the quarterly external audit if it contends a monthly memo serves that role, or to state the schedule and first period end date if it contends no quarter has closed.

policy_promises.quote: an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly for internal ALPR users and quarterly for external CA public agency users
policy_promises.tests: Whether any quarterly external-user audit has been conducted since the policy took effect on 2025-12-22, and under what schedule.

policy_promises.quote: The audit shall be documented in the form of an internal department memorandum to the Chief of Police
policy_promises.tests: Whether a memorandum exists for each closed quarterly period, distinct from the monthly internal-user memoranda.

policy_promises.quote: After review by the Chief of Police, the memorandum and any associated documentation shall be filed and retained
policy_promises.tests: What review, filing, and retention records exist, and what the retained "associated documentation" consists of.

prior_pra_refs.note: Closed 2026-04-08 with four monthly memoranda (Dec 2025 – Mar 2026) and "We have no additional records" — no separate quarterly external-user audit.
Asked for the April/May 2026 monthly continuation and any quarterly external-user audit records.
Produced the Policy 463 text effective 2025-12-22 that item 463.10 is quoted from.

filed_because: Policy 463.10 imposes two audit cadences, and only the monthly internal one has produced records. Enough time has now passed that at least two quarterly periods have closed under any reading of the schedule, so the request is framed to cover every plausible schedule and to force the Department to either produce the quarterly external audits or state which schedule it applies.
notes:
Filed 2026-08-17; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-08-27.

Each item is severable, with a request that partial responses proceed on the statutory timeline rather than extending the request as a whole. Item 4 asks only for identification of the retained documentation, not the exports themselves; item 5 is limited to transmittal, routing, review, and filing records for the memoranda, not a general email search.
